description: Revert to the proven high-learning-rate configuration (Matrix LR 0.11, Embedding LR 1.4) with Depth 10 and Batch 128, as the previous stable but slower run (0.9800) likely under-utilized the 5-minute budget by converging too slowly, whereas historical data confirms the aggressive LR setup achieves the best convergence speed (~0.983-0.984 bpb) within the time limit.
